payload.name: harmony-hdc
payload.description: Hyperdimensional Computing (HDC/VSA) expert for mo:os — binding, bundling, permutation, wire encoding, GPU mapping. Use when reasoning about vector representations of graphs, similarity search, or GPU acceleration.
payload.when_not_to_use:
- ❌ Treating Embedding functor output as ground truth (it's a VIEW)
- ❌ Binary decomposition of n-ary wire relations
- ❌ Serial graph traversal when HDC similarity search suffices
- ❌ Ignoring temporal ordering (use permutation π^k)
